title: Traders Overwhelmed by Iran News Are Turning to AI for Help
title_zh: 因伊朗新闻而不知所措的交易者正在向人工智能寻求帮助
summary: “I was up for almost 48 hours straight, monitoring the interceptions in the United Arab Emirates while simultaneously running scenarios and preparing for the market open,” said Visseau, who’s based in Dubai and specializes in macro trading strategies.
summary_zh: “我几乎连续 48 个小时都在监视阿拉伯联合酋长国的拦截情况，同时运行情景并为市场开盘做准备，”驻迪拜、专门研究宏观交易策略的维索说道。

title: Alibaba, Tencent Shares Lose $66 Billion as AI Vision Falls Flat
title_zh: AI 视觉表现不佳，阿里巴巴和腾讯股价损失 660 亿美元
summary: Alibaba’s US shares fell their most since October, following Tencent’s worst drubbing in almost a year on Thursday.
summary_zh: 周四，腾讯遭遇近一年来最严重的惨败，阿里巴巴美国股市跌幅创 10 月份以来最大跌幅。

title: Exclusive-Tesla in talks with Chinese firms to buy $2.9 billion worth of solar equipment, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，特斯拉正在与中国公司洽谈购买价值 29 亿美元的太阳能设备
summary: Tesla is looking to buy equipment worth $2.9 billion for manufacturing solar panels and cells from Chinese suppliers including Suzhou Maxwell Technologies, two people familiar with the matter said, as CEO Elon Musk aims to add 100 gigawatts of solar capacity in the United Stat...
summary_zh: 两位知情人士表示，特斯拉正寻求从苏州麦克斯韦科技公司等中国供应商购买价值 29 亿美元的设备，用于制造太阳能电池板和电池，首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的目标是在美国增加 100 吉瓦的太阳能装机容量。

title: Is the BMW i3 EV's 440 mile range enough to take on Tesla?
title_zh: BMW i3 EV 440 英里的续航里程足以与特斯拉抗衡吗？
summary: The 2027 BMW (BMW.DE, BMW.SG) i3 EV sedan is said to be a new challenger to Tesla's Model 3 (TSLA), touting a 440-mile range on a single charge.
summary_zh: 据称，2027 款 BMW (BMW.DE、BMW.SG) i3 电动轿车是特斯拉 Model 3 (TSLA) 的新挑战者，一次充电可行驶 440 英里。

title: Uber to invest $1.25B in Rivian in exchange for 50K robotaxis
title_zh: Uber 将向 Rivian 投资 1.25B 美元，以换取 5 万辆机器人出租车
summary: Uber (UBER) is planning to invest up to $1.25 billion in Rivian (RIVN), in exchange for the automaker reportedly supplying the rideshare giant with an autonomous fleet of 50,000 EVs.
summary_zh: Uber (UBER) 计划向 Rivian (RIVN) 投资最多 12.5 亿美元，据报道，作为交换条件，该汽车制造商将向这家共享出行巨头提供一支由 5 万辆电动汽车组成的自动驾驶车队。

title: Market Madness: Why JPMorgan, McDonald's are slam dunk stock picks
title_zh: 市场疯狂：为何摩根大通、麦当劳是绝佳选股
summary: Tipping off Yahoo Finance's "Market Madness" bracket tournament, Winthrop Capital CIO Adam Coons joins Julie Hyman to make the case for the first round of corporate match-ups, which includes JPMorgan Chase (JPM) vs. TJX (TJX) and McDonald's (MCD) vs. Disney (DIS).
summary_zh: Winthrop Capital 首席信息官 Adam Coons 与 Julie Hyman 一起为雅虎财经的“市场疯狂”分组赛揭幕，为第一轮企业对决进行论证，其中包括摩根大通 (JPM) 对阵 TJX (TJX) 以及麦当劳 (MCD) 对阵迪士尼 (DIS)。
